Redacted Regiment is a Premium Warbond available for 1,000 Super Credits in the Warbonds tab of the Acquisition Center.

Contents

  • 1 Overview
  • 2 Contents
    • 2.1 Page 1
    • 2.2 Page 2
    • 2.3 Page 3
  • 3 Media

  • 5 Change History

Overview

Players can use Medals to claim various items. These rewards are spread across three pages, each requiring increasingly more Medals (ranging from 2 to 110). Players start on page one, unlocking subsequent pages as they spend more Medals, gradually expanding their customization options.

Redacted Regiment is a warbond that focuses on Stealth tactics, featuring equipment useful for sneaking around enemies and making silent kills.

Notes

In order to fix "a key issue that didn't meet our standards for a release" [1], the Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond was delayed by two days, instead releasing on Thursday, January 22nd, 2026.

There are also Redacted Regiment themed items in the Permanent Catalog on the Superstore.
